Nora (CS): heads-up CedarWave renewal is stuck behind procurement compliance. They require a bank wire + notarized signature, and they want term shortened to 9 months. onboarding blocked until payment clears :disappointed:
Tomas (AE): do we have a PO? procurement asked for an invoice stub they can attach to the PO request
Nora (CS): not yet. asked for vendor code, approver email, and whether scanned notary is allowed
Eli (Finance): we can add wire instructions. which billing entity? CedarWave Ltd (EU) or CedarWave, Inc (US)?
Tomas (AE): they prefer EU billing for this contract
Maya (Legal): for 9mo term we need to redline auto-renew and confirm indemnity remains. scanned notarized signature accepted? depends on country, but usually OK if notarization present
Nora (CS): uploading amendment draft and SOW: https://docs.redwood/cedar/amend-1943 and https://files.redwood/sow/cedar-sow-1943.pdf
Nora (CS): @invoice-bot please generate manual invoice stub with wire details, NET30, billing_entity="CedarWave Ltd"
invoice-bot: created manual invoice INV-2026-1133 for CedarWave. PDF: https://invoices.redwood/inv/INV-2026-1133
Eli (Finance): added remittance: Bank: Redwood Bank, IBAN: RWDXGB99, SWIFT: RWDXGB22. set payment_terms=Net30, billing_entity="CedarWave Ltd"
Tomas (AE): I'll send invoice+SOW+amendment to procurement. requesting PO# and approver name. ETA 30m
Nora (CS): procurement asked for explicit 'deliverables: onboarding workshop x1' line on invoice and SOW must be a PDF attached not a link
Eli (Finance): updated INV-2026-1133: added line_item "Onboarding workshop (1 session)". status=PENDING
Maya (Legal): posted redlines in amendment: removed auto-renew, adjusted termination notice to 30 days, added signature block for notarized scan
Tomas (AE): sent package to procurement (Sarita Rao). asked if scanned notarized signature ok and requested PO by EOD
invoice-bot: payment status for INV-2026-1133 = PENDING (no payment event yet)
Nora (CS): procurement replied: vendor code CW-EU-9001, approver Sarita.Rao@cedarwave.eu, they will attach notarized scan and submit PO CW-PO-9011 tomorrow AM
Eli (Finance): note: if wire arrives please include PO# in payment reference for recon
Tomas (AE): got PO# CW-PO-9011 and notarized scan attached. uploading to internal case
Maya (Legal): confirming signatory on scanned doc matches PO approver. looks good, will sign off on amendment once payment terms confirmed
Eli (Finance): monitoring bank for incoming wire. will mark INV-2026-1133 PAID when funds clear
Nora (CS): tentatively holding kickoff week of Jun 7. if payment delayed >72h switch to asynchronous enablement pack
Tomas (AE): following up with procurement to expedite wire. will report back
Nora (CS): thanks team. will close loop after invoice marked PAID. :sparkles:
